en: Black‑and‑white image of a monumental equestrian statue on a high stone plinth. The sculpture shows a rearing horse being restrained by a man in traditional military or folk dress with wide trousers and a broad‑brimmed hat. The monument stands on a broad terrace or bridge-like platform with balustrades. In the distant background are low hills and early 20th‑century European-style buildings. The image is framed like an old photographic postcard, but no printed text is visible on the front.
